title: Bad Bunny, Burna Boy & Slayer: GTA 6's Six Radio Stations (and In-Game Podcasts!) Revealed
subtitle: Six stations, two hosts each, and podcasts for the first time
excerpt: Rockstar's October 8 Newswire reveal gave us six GTA 6 radio stations with celebrity hosts — Bad Bunny, Burna Boy, Kerry King and more — plus the series' first on-demand podcasts. Here's every station and playlist detail confirmed so far.
content:
Last Thursday — October 8, if your calendar matters — Rockstar did something it rarely does. It gave us actual content about GTA 6, weeks before launch, and it wasn't another car chase trailer. The Rockstar Newswire announced six GTA 6 radio stations, complete with celebrity hosts, playlist names, and a new music page on rockstargames.com where you can preview each station in two-minute samples. Oh, and one more thing buried in the announcement: Grand Theft Auto VI is the first game in the series with on-demand podcasts.

Let's be honest — radio is where Vice City won. 2002's Emotion 98.3 still lives in every millennial's head. So Rockstar calling this the "biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet" is a serious promise. Here's what's actually confirmed so far, with each station getting two hosts.

## The Latin station: Bad Bunny goes full El Martillo

![Vice City skyline in GTA 6](/img/hero-vice-skyline.jpg)

The modern Latin station covers bachata, merengue, dembow, and reggaeton. The hosts are El Martillo, voiced by Bad Bunny, and La Gata, voiced by RaiNao. Benito's own track "EoO" is confirmed in the rotation, which means somewhere in Leonida you'll be doing 90 down the Palmetto Expressway while a global superstar DJs your getaway.

## Back Country Radio: country with a Vice City edge

The renegade country station is hosted by MW (voiced by Morgan Wallen) and Delta Dawne (voiced by Lana Del Rey), with roving reporter Mud Dog Mike (voiced by Jeremy Dufrene) filing from the field. The playlist includes Loretta Lynn and David Allan Coe — old-school outlaw country rubbing shoulders with the modern Florida sprawl outside Ambrosia. This is the station that will soundtrack every drive through the Grassrivers wetlands, and I am not mad about it.

## AfroBank FM: Burna Boy and Palms Trax

AfroBank FM is hosted by Burna (voiced by Burna Boy) and Palmsy (voiced by Palms Trax), spanning 20th-century African classics through to amapiano and 3-step. This is a genuinely new flavor for the series — GTA radio has touched on Afrobeat-adjacent sounds before, but a dedicated African music station with Burna Boy himself behind the mic is a first.

## The Chamber 106.6: metal done properly

Classic metal gets the royal treatment with DJ Kerry (voiced by Kerry King of Slayer) and DJ Tom (voiced by Tom Araya, also of Slayer). The confirmed playlist: Black Sabbath, Pantera, Slayer. That's not a station, that's a mosh pit with wheels. The Chamber 106.6 will be the default soundtrack for anyone running a five-star rampage down Ocean Drive.

## Flash FM returns

![Car cruising through Vice City](/img/car-pink.jpg)

Vice City natives, wipe the tear. Flash FM is back, this time hosted by Robyn and Alex Consani, playing Charli xcx, MGMT, and Zara Larsson with PinkPantheress. Flash FM defined 80s Vice City in 2002 and 2006; its 2026 incarnation leaning into modern pop is a perfect mirror of the city itself — same name, entirely new money.

## Dirty South Classics: Trick Daddy and Trina

Regional rap and hip-hop get their due with hosts Trick Daddy and Trina — actual Miami legends — and tracks from David Banner, JT Money, and DJ Khaled. This is the station that gives Leonida its street-level credibility. If any station ends up blasting from every lowrider in Little Haiti's in-game equivalent, it's this one.


Hear these stations in context in our [[Trailer 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKUW7_I4QwA Breakdown](/news/gta-6-trailer-2-breakdown). Meet the characters in our [GTA 6 Characters Guide](/news/gta-6-characters-lucia-jason-cast).


| Station | Genre | Notable Artists |
|---------|-------|---------------|
| Latin station | Latin/Reggaeton | Bad Bunny |
| Back Country Radio | Country | Various |
| AfroBank FM | Afrobeats | Burna Boy, Palms Trax |
| The Chamber 106.6 | Metal | Slayer |
| Flash FM | 80s Pop | Returning from Vice City |
| Dirty South Classics | Hip-Hop | Trick Daddy, Trina |

## What else is confirmed (and what's not)

Rockstar also confirmed classic rock and talk radio options exist beyond these six — so the full dial is bigger than what we've seen. The six named stations are just the beginning. The 34-track GTA VI: The Album, announced separately, suggests licensed music is a much bigger production this time around.

As for the podcasts: Rockstar confirmed they're on-demand, but hasn't explained how they'll work in-game. Will they be story-driven true-crime shows set in Leonida? Talk segments you can pause and resume? Unannounced — file it under "wait and hear." With the game landing November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, we won't be guessing much longer. Seven-day preload starts November 12 for pre-ordered editions, so your first decision might not be which car to steal — it might be which station you tune to first.

title: GTA 6 Release Date, Pre-Order Guide & All Editions Explained
excerpt: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here's the complete pre-order guide: both editions, prices, bonuses, pre-load dates, and what physical buyers need to know.
content:
## When Is GTA 6 Coming Out?

![Vice City skyline in GTA 6](/img/hero-vice-skyline.jpg)

Thursday, November 19, 2026. PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. That's the date [Rockstar set](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire) on November 6, 2025, and it hasn't budged since. Take-Two Interactive reaffirmed it in their August 7, 2026 earnings release, and Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told Famitsu in late August 2026 that "it will definitely be released."

For clarity: the November 19, 2026 date and the PS5 + Xbox Series X|S platforms are confirmed. The PC version is unconfirmed — based on Rockstar's history you'd expect late 2027 to 2028, but nothing has been announced.

## GTA 6 Delay History

It's been a long road. Two official delays:

1. Fall 2025 — the original window, announced alongside Trailer 1 back in December 2023
2. May 26, 2026 — the first delay, announced in May 2025 (Trailer 2 dropped that same week)
3. November 19, 2026 — the second and final delay, announced in November 2025, citing polish. Take-Two's stock dropped up to 18% on the news

Here's where things stand now. Since September 1, 2026, there hasn't been a single credible delay report. The "delayed again" claims floating around online are parody or opinion posts, not reporting. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick says he feels "very good" about the timeline — and honestly, at this point the date feels locked.

## What Platforms Is GTA 6 On?

Short version:

- PlayStation 5 — confirmed
- Xbox Series X|S — confirmed
- PC — not announced. Rockstar has never committed to a PC version. Going by their history (GTA 5 took about 18–19 months; RDR2 about 13), late 2027 to early 2028 is a reasonable estimate — but that's arithmetic, not a roadmap. Rumors of Xbox PC streaming at launch are unconfirmed.


| Edition | Price | Availability |
|---------|-------|--------------|
| Standard Edition | $79.99 | Physical + Digital |
| Ultimate Edition | $99.99 | Digital only |

## GTA 6 Editions & Prices

![GTA 6 official logo](/img/gta6-official-logo.png)

Two editions. No more, no less.

### Standard Edition — $79.99

The full GTA 6 game, available physical (code-in-a-box) and digital — and it includes the pre-order bonus pack if you buy before the cutoff (details below).

### Ultimate Edition — $99.99 (digital only)

Everything in Standard, plus a genuinely stacked bonus list:

- Premium story vehicles: '95 Grotti Cheetah, Shitzu Squalo, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, and the Vapid Ganado modkit
- Personalized weapons: Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers
- Exclusive apparel and tattoos
- Ultimate-only shops: Rideout Customs, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, Electric Fang Tattoo
- A Special Commission to restore classic cars

And here's a telling stat — per pcguide data, roughly 9 in 10 pre-orders are for the Ultimate Edition. Make of that what you will.

### What's NOT Available

No Special Edition or Collector's game edition exists — those were never a thing. Separately, Rockstar sells "The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection," a $399.99 merchandise box with 11 items including a double-sided poster. It ships November 19, it's a Rockstar Store exclusive, it's one per person — and it does not include the game.

One more thing: remember the 2025 analyst predictions of a $100 base price (Michael Pachter, among others)? They were wrong.


See the story behind the game in our [Trailer 2 Breakdown](/news/gta-6-trailer-2-breakdown). Meet the characters in our [GTA 6 Characters Guide](/news/gta-6-characters-lucia-jason-cast).

## GTA 6 Pre-Order Guide

### When Did Pre-Orders Open?

June 25, 2026 — across the PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, Rockstar Store, and major US retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, GameStop, Target).

### Pre-Order Bonus: Vintage Vice City Pack

Anyone who buys before November 20, 2026 — launch-day buyers qualify — gets the Vintage Vice City Pack. That's the '55 Vapid Stanier vintage sedan, an Ocean Beach garage, vintage outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, and weapon patterns inspired by Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt. Digital pre-orders also get a month of GTA+ free.

### Pre-Load & Launch Logistics

The practical stuff, because launch week is always chaos:

- Pre-load opens November 12, 2026 — a full week before launch
- Launch unlock is midnight local time, rolling worldwide (starting with New Zealand around 11:00 UTC on Nov 18)
- Physical copies contain a download code, not a disc — so physical buyers pre-load once their code arrives
- No early access via pre-order; all editions launch simultaneously on Nov 19

### Should You Pre-Order?

Here's the thing. With both Rockstar and Take-Two reaffirming the date as recently as August 2026, and zero credible delay signals anywhere, pre-ordering is low-risk. And the Vintage Vice City Pack is free with any pre-launch purchase — so there's genuinely no downside to ordering before Nov 20.

## GTA 6 Accessories

Sony unveiled GTA 6 limited-edition DualSense controllers — black and white — at State of Play on September 3, 2026. They're $84.99 each, pre-orders opened September 10, 2026, and they launch alongside the game on Nov 19. The black one is a PlayStation Direct exclusive, and limited quantities sold out quickly at several retailers. If you're on the fence about the white one, don't sleep on it.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the GTA 6 release date?
Thursday, November 19, 2026 — confirmed for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It's been holding since November 2025, so circle it.

### Has GTA 6 been delayed?
Twice — from Fall 2025 to May 2026 to November 2026. But the November 19, 2026 date has held firm since November 2025, and there are no credible new delay reports. The "delayed again" stuff you see online is parody, not news.

### Is GTA 6 coming to PC?
Not announced. Rockstar's track record suggests late 2027 to 2028 is plausible, but that's our estimate, not a promise — still unconfirmed.

### How much does GTA 6 cost?
$79.99 for Standard, $99.99 for Ultimate (digital only).

### Do physical GTA 6 copies have a disc?
Nope. Physical copies are code-in-a-box — a download code, no disc. Pre-load opens November 12, 2026, so you'll be ready either way.

### What do you get for pre-ordering GTA 6?
The Vintage Vice City Pack — the '55 Vapid Stanier, an Ocean Beach garage, vintage outfits, and weapon patterns inspired by Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt — plus a free month of GTA+ on digital pre-orders.

excerpt: Rockstar's 91-second GTA 6 reveal introduced Lucia, modern Vice City, and a Bonnie-and-Clyde crime story. Here's every detail, Easter egg, and hidden clue from Trailer 1.
content:
## What Did GTA 6 [Trailer 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QdBZY2fkU-0 Reveal?

Ninety-one seconds. That's all Rockstar needed.

On December 4, 2023, the first GTA 6 trailer dropped and did four things at once: it introduced Lucia — the first woman to headline a mainline GTA — confirmed we're going back to a modern-day Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida, and set up what looks like a Bonnie-and-Clyde crime story. All of it set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road." Honestly, this might be the best trailer Rockstar has ever cut.

The trailer closed with a "Coming 2025" window for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar confirmed the 91-second runtime, the December 4 release date, and the soundtrack itself. The viewership numbers come from outlet roundups — around 93 million YouTube views in 24 hours, though exact figures vary between sources.

## When Did GTA 6 Trailer 1 Come Out?

The story of how it came out is almost as good as the trailer itself.

On December 1, 2023, Rockstar Games founder Sam Houser announced — as part of the studio's 25th anniversary — that the first GTA 6 trailer would premiere on December 5, 2023, at 9 AM ET. Simple enough. Except the trailer leaked the night before.

On the evening of December 4, a low-quality copy watermarked "BUY $BTC" appeared on X, posted by the account @Gta6trailerleak. Rockstar responded by pulling the official release forward several hours, posting the real trailer on YouTube with a note telling viewers to watch the genuine version. We've seen leaks before, but a watermarked leak forcing Rockstar's hand on its biggest reveal in a decade? That's a first.

**Key timeline:**
- **Dec 1, 2023** — Sam Houser announces trailer date (Dec 5, 9 AM ET)
- **Dec 4, 2023 (evening)** — Leaked copy with "BUY $BTC" watermark surfaces on X
- **Dec 4, 2023 (night)** — Rockstar publishes the official trailer early on YouTube

## Who Is Lucia in GTA 6 Trailer 1?

The trailer opens on Lucia in an orange prison jumpsuit inside Leonida Penitentiary, talking to what appears to be a parole board or counselor. Asked why she's behind bars, she just says: "bad luck, I guess."

That one shot did a lot of heavy lifting. First, it made Lucia the first female protagonist in a mainline Grand Theft Auto game — a genuinely historic moment for the series. Second, the prison setting told us crime and consequences were going to be central themes. And third, her calm, defiant delivery hinted at a character who owns her choices. We were sold immediately.

Rockstar's later official character bios filled in the rest: Lucia Caminos' father taught her to fight from childhood, and fighting for her family landed her in Leonida Penitentiary. Her full backstory is covered in our [GTA 6 characters guide](/characters).

## What Is Leonida in GTA 6?

![Leonida map showing the GTA 6 game world](/img/leonida-map-v2.jpg)

Trailer 1 confirmed the game is set in the fictional state of Leonida — Rockstar's version of Florida — with a modern-day Vice City as its centerpiece. This is the first return to Vice City since GTA: Vice City Stories back in 2006. Twenty real-world years.

The trailer paints Leonida as a sun-soaked, chaotic, larger-than-life version of Florida. You've got Vice Beach, with its packed beaches, oceanfront highways, and neon-soaked nightlife. There's urban Vice City itself — downtown skylines, rooftop parties, street culture. And then there's rural Leonida: swamps, backroads, and small-town Florida. Our full [GTA 6 map guide](/map) breaks down all six confirmed regions of Leonida.

## GTA 6 Trailer 1: Scene-by-Scene Breakdown

### 1. Leonida Penitentiary — Lucia's Introduction (0:00–0:10)
The trailer opens inside the prison. Lucia, in an orange jumpsuit, sits across from an evaluator. Notice how muted the institutional tones are compared to everything that follows — a deliberate choice, showing us where her story starts versus where it's going.

### 2. Vice Beach Montage — "Florida Man" Energy (0:10–0:35)
Then the floodgates open. A rapid montage of Vice City life plays over Tom Petty's guitar: beachgoers, jet skis, oceanfront cruising. An alligator wandering into a convenience store — because of course. Street takeovers and drag racing. A mud-club party with trucks buried to the axles. And running through it all, in-game social media livestreams showing over-the-top civilian behavior. That's a new satirical layer for the series, and it feels like it's going to be a big one.

### 3. News Reports & Chaos (0:35–0:55)
Local news broadcasts report on the mayhem: police chases, robberies, Vice City's signature brand of disorder. These interstitials do more than fill time — they sell the living-world feel. Leonida reacts to crime in real time.

### 4. The Duo — Robbery & Getaway (0:55–1:15)
Lucia and her male partner rob a convenience store together, flee from police, and share intimate moments. The trailer never names him — but the 2022 leaks called him Jason, and Rockstar later confirmed him as Jason Duval in Trailer 2. This is the section that established the Bonnie-and-Clyde dynamic at the story's heart, and honestly, this is where the trailer gave us chills.

### 5. The Closing Shot — Trust (1:15–1:31)
It ends quietly. The pair sits on a car hood overlooking the Vice City skyline at dusk, and the dialogue keeps coming back to "sticking together" — to trust. That's the emotional thesis of the entire game, delivered in one still frame.

## GTA 6 Trailer 1 Easter Eggs & Hidden Details

The song choice alone deserves a paragraph. "Love Is a Long Road" isn't just a great needle drop — it's a Florida rock anthem about a long, hard journey, which maps pretty directly onto Lucia and Jason's story.

Then there's the leak itself. The "BUY $BTC" watermarked copy became part of GTA 6 history, forcing Rockstar's hand on the release timing. Years from now, people will still talk about how Trailer 1 came out.

Look closely at the social media UI in those livestream overlays, too. It suggests social media plays a bigger gameplay role than in any prior GTA — and we'll see that theory pay off later. The male partner's appearance also matched the "Jason" character from the September 2022 source-code hack, which Rockstar later confirmed as authentic. And of course, the end card promised "Coming 2025" — a window that later slipped. See our [release date guide](/news/gta-6-release-date-pre-order-editions) for how that played out.


| Record | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Views in 24 hours | Over 90 million |
| Likes | Most-liked gaming trailer debut |
| Release date | December 4, 2023 |

## GTA 6 Trailer 1 Records

It shattered YouTube records on release. Roughly 46 million views in 12 hours. Around 93 million in 24 hours — among the most-viewed videos ever in a single day, behind only two BTS music videos.

A small caveat: those view counts come from outlet roundups like Wccftech, and exact 24-hour figures vary between sources. Either way, it was a monster.

### Vehicles Spotted in GTA 6 Trailer 1

![Pink car spotted in GTA 6 trailer](/img/car-pink.jpg)

Car enthusiasts cataloged dozens of vehicles across the 91 seconds. The standouts: the Declasse Tulip (a donked lowrider — and the car Jason and Lucia drive), the Bravado Banshee, Maibatsu Sanchez dirt bikes, the Buckingham Maverick helicopter, a Pfister Comet S2 convertible on Vice Beach, the Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, a white Grotti Cheetah Classic, and the Mammoth Dodo seaplane towing a banner.

See every confirmed vehicle with official screenshots in our [GTA 6 vehicles database](/vehicles).

## What Trailer 1 Didn't Show

For all its 91 seconds, the trailer held a lot back:

- **No gameplay footage** — it's entirely cinematic
- **No PC version** — only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S were mentioned
- **No exact release date** — just the "2025" window
- **Jason's name** — the male protagonist went unnamed until Trailer 2

- [Rockstar Games Newswire](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### When was GTA 6 Trailer 1 released?
It came out on December 4, 2023 — officially, anyway. A leaked copy forced Rockstar to publish it hours ahead of the scheduled December 5 premiere, so the leak technically got there first.

### How long is GTA 6 Trailer 1?
Just 91 seconds, set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road." Somehow it felt way longer than that.

### Who is the girl in GTA 6 Trailer 1?
That's Lucia Caminos — the first female protagonist in a mainline GTA game. She's introduced in Leonida Penitentiary wearing an orange jumpsuit, telling an evaluator she's there because of "bad luck, I guess."

### Where is GTA 6 set?
The fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida, centered on a modern-day Vice City. It's the series' first return there since 2006.

### Was GTA 6 Trailer 1 leaked?
Yes. A low-quality copy watermarked "BUY $BTC" leaked on X hours before the scheduled premiere, and Rockstar responded by releasing the official version early. The leak is now part of GTA 6 lore.

### Is GTA 6 Trailer 1 actual gameplay?
Nope — it's entirely cinematic. The first real gameplay footage came much later in the Netflix Extended Look (August 2026). Check out our [breakdown](/news/gta-6-netflix-extended-look-breakdown) of that one.

content:
## What Did GTA 6 [Trailer 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKUW7_I4QwA Reveal?

No announcement. No countdown. Rockstar just dropped it.

On May 6, 2025, a nearly 3-minute trailer appeared out of nowhere, and it did what the first one didn't: it gave both protagonists full names — Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos — and laid out their criminal-romantic partnership in detail. We met key supporting characters including Brian Heder, Cal Hampton, and Raul Bautista. We got real story specifics: an "easy score" gone wrong that drags the pair into a conspiracy across Leonida. And like Trailer 1, it was captured on a standard PS5.

Rockstar confirmed the release date, the roughly 3-minute runtime, the protagonist names, the story synopsis, the soundtrack, and the PS5 capture. The reported 60M+ YouTube views in 24 hours comes from outlet figures — exact numbers vary by source.

## When Did GTA 6 Trailer 2 Come Out?

Timing is everything, and Rockstar knew it.

Trailer 2 arrived with zero advance notice on May 6, 2025 — just days after Rockstar announced the game's first delay, pushing the release from Fall 2025 to May 26, 2026. The surprise drop was widely read as Rockstar softening the delay news with new footage. Honestly, it worked. Nobody was talking about the delay that week.

**Key timeline:**
- **Early May 2025** — Rockstar announces delay to May 26, 2026
- **May 6, 2025** — Trailer 2 drops unannounced, nearly 3 minutes long
- The trailer immediately shattered viewership records — reported at 60M+ in 24 hours, with exact figures varying by outlet

## Who Are Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos?

![Jason Duval in GTA 6](/img/char-jason.jpg)

Trailer 2 finally named both protagonists and gave them real backstories. Here's what we learned.

### Jason Duval
We meet Jason fixing roof leaks on a run-down house, and his throwaway line — "just fixing some leaks" — is a deliberate nod to the September 2022 source-code hack. A wink from Rockstar to the fans who followed the leaks. We love that kind of thing.

Jason works for Brian Heder, who sends him to collect checks from properties — and we see him physically confronting someone over rent money. Rockstar's backstory fills in the rest: Jason grew up around small-time grifters in the Leonida Keys, escaped that life through a stint in the Army, and now runs jobs for local drug runners. He wants an easy life but keeps getting pulled back into crime. The trailer shows him working out, running corner-store errands, living a grounded working-class life. He's the relatable half of this duo.

### Lucia Caminos
Lucia walks out of Leonida Penitentiary at the trailer's start, with Jason waiting outside. She's free — but on parole with an ankle monitor, performing community service. Freedom comes with conditions.

Her backstory: her father taught her to fight from the time she could walk, and fighting for her family put her behind bars. Her mother dreamed of the good life since their days in Liberty City. And now, as she puts it, she's fiercely committed to her plan — no matter what it takes.

### Their Relationship
Rockstar's official synopsis: after an "easy score" goes wrong, Jason and Lucia end up "on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America," caught in a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever to survive.

Rockstar also confirmed something interesting about the romance: it's optional, and it gives no direct gameplay advantage. But it does affect the story. And ignoring a partner's messages can weaken the relationship. Trust as a gameplay system — that's new territory for GTA.

## New Characters Introduced in Trailer 2

![Lucia Caminos in GTA 6](/img/char-lucia.jpg)

Beyond the leads, Trailer 2 introduced the supporting cast — and it's a strong lineup.

**Brian Heder** is Jason's boss: a landlord and veteran drug smuggler operating in the Leonida Keys, sending Jason out on collection jobs. **Cal Hampton** is Jason's friend, a conspiracy-obsessed loner who'll presumably provide both comic relief and questionable advice. **Raul Bautista** is a seasoned bank robber — some outlets spell it "Batista" — and clearly a big player. Then there's the music-world contingent: **Boobie Ike**, a street-smart entrepreneur who runs the Only Raw Records label; **Dre'Quan Priest**, a driven music producer in Boobie's orbit; and **Real Dimez**, the rap duo (Bae-Luxe and Roxy) who are social-media sensations signed to Boobie's label.

Full bios for all eight officially profiled characters are in our [GTA 6 characters guide](/characters).

## GTA 6 Trailer 2 Soundtrack

Four songs made the cut:

1. **"Hot Together"** — Pointer Sisters
2. **"Everybody Have Fun Tonight"** — Wang Chung
3. **"Child Support"** — Zenglen
4. **"Talkin' to Myself Again"** — Tammy Wynette

The mix of 80s pop, Haitian kompa (Zenglen), and country says a lot about Leonida's cultural melting pot. And it continues GTA's long tradition of era-defining licensed music — the soundtrack curation is half the identity of these games.


| Key Scene | What It Reveals |
|-----------|----------------|
| Jason & Lucia reunion | Their relationship drives the story |
| Heist planning | Multi-stage robberies return |
| Leonida landscapes | Diverse environments across the state |
| Police response | Enhanced wanted system |

## GTA 6 Trailer 2: Key Scenes & Story Beats

### Jason's Daily Grind
The trailer opens on Jason's working-class routine: fixing a roof, collecting debts for Brian, hitting the gym, running errands. This is Rockstar grounding him as a relatable protagonist before the criminal escalation begins. Smart storytelling — we care about him before the chaos.

### Lucia's Release
Jason waits outside Leonida Penitentiary as Lucia walks free — ankle monitor and all. Their reunion is tender but tense. She's out, but she's not free. Not really.

### The Heists Escalate
Then the montage kicks in. Armed robberies build in scale: convenience store hits echoing Trailer 1, then a bank vault physically towed away by a vehicle. And then there's the shot everyone talked about — Lucia wielding an automatic grenade launcher. Honestly, this shot gave us chills. It might be the single most replayed frame of the trailer.

### Jason the Hacker
Pay attention to this one: Jason is shown using a smartphone to hack security systems. That reads less like set dressing and more like a real gameplay mechanic — phone-based hacking as something you'll actually do.

### Leonida on Display
The trailer confirms new locations on screen: the Vice City beachfront, the Grassrivers wetlands, the Leonida Keys, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park. The geography is coming into focus.

### The Emotional Core
Between the action, the trailer makes room for the relationship: yacht parties, jet skis, drinking on a pier, arguments, reconciliation. It's selling the romance as much as the crime. That's the bet Rockstar is making here.

## Gameplay Hints in Trailer 2

For a cinematic trailer, Trailer 2 smuggled in plenty of gameplay signals. For starters, Phil's Ammu-Nation is back — the franchise's iconic gun store returns. Then there's Jason's smartphone hack of a security system, which reads less like set dressing and more like an interactive mechanic you'll actually use.

The heist scenes show Jason and Lucia operating as a team in real time, which points toward real dual-protagonist heists rather than just scripted story beats. Lucia's ankle monitor isn't just character detail either — later Rockstar interviews confirmed it plays a major story role. And one last thing worth knowing: all footage was captured on base PS5, which tells you the visual target for launch hardware.

Deeper gameplay systems — character switching, the Heat system, robbery tiers — were revealed later in the Netflix Extended Look. See our [gameplay guide](/news/gta-6-gameplay-confirmed-features-mechanics).


## Sources

- [GTA 6 Trailer 2 (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKUW7_I4QwA)
- [Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI)
- [Rockstar Games Newswire](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### When was GTA 6 Trailer 2 released?
May 6, 2025, with zero announcement — dropped out of nowhere just days after Rockstar delayed the game to May 26, 2026. The timing was not a coincidence.

### How long is GTA 6 Trailer 2?
Nearly 3 minutes — roughly twice the length of Trailer 1's 91 seconds. Rockstar clearly had more to say this time.

### What are the GTA 6 protagonists' full names?
Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, both confirmed in Trailer 2. Lucia appeared (unnamed) in Trailer 1.

### What songs are in GTA 6 Trailer 2?
"Hot Together" (Pointer Sisters), "Everybody Have Fun Tonight" (Wang Chung), "Child Support" (Zenglen), and "Talkin' to Myself Again" (Tammy Wynette). Quite the range — 80s pop to Haitian kompa to country.

### Is the GTA 6 romance optional?
Yes — Rockstar confirmed it. The Jason/Lucia romance is optional, gives no direct gameplay advantage, but it does affect the story. Ignore your partner's messages and the relationship weakens.

### Was GTA 6 Trailer 2 actual gameplay?
No — like Trailer 1, it's cinematic. Both trailers were captured on PS5, but the first real gameplay footage didn't arrive until the Netflix Extended Look (August 2026).

title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: Every Major Difference Confirmed So Far
subtitle: Thirteen years after GTA 5, Rockstar is rebuilding its open-world formula around two leads, a broader Leonida setting, deeper interactions and more consequential police and combat systems. Here is what has actually changed, what is confirmed, and what remains uncertain before launch.
excerpt: Thirteen years after GTA 5, Rockstar is rebuilding its open-world formula around two leads, a broader Leonida setting, deeper interactions and more consequential police and combat systems. Here is what has actually changed, what is confirmed, and what remains uncertain before launch.
content:
**Quick answer:** GTA 6 keeps the open-world crime foundation of GTA 5 but changes the scale and systems around it. Rockstar is moving from three protagonists to Jason and Lucia, from Los Santos and Blaine County to the wider state of Leonida, and from GTA 5's simpler five-star police loop to a more detailed wanted system shown in 2026 footage and previews. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

## GTA 6 vs GTA 5 at a Glance

- **Launch:** GTA 5 — September 17, 2013 on PS3 / Xbox 360. GTA 6 — November 19, 2026 on PS5 / Xbox Series X|S.
- **Main setting:** GTA 5 — Los Santos and Blaine County, San Andreas. GTA 6 — the state of Leonida, including Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
- **Playable leads:** GTA 5 — Michael, Franklin and Trevor. GTA 6 — [Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos](/characters).
- **Story structure:** GTA 5 — three separate lives that intersect. GTA 6 — a two-person criminal partnership at the center of the story.
- **Wanted system:** GTA 5 — five-star maximum. GTA 6 — six-slot / six-star wanted presentation shown and reported in 2026 previews, with more detailed suspect information.
- **Interaction:** GTA 5 — more limited ambient interaction. GTA 6 — broader contextual NPC and world interactions shown in the Extended Look.
- **Combat direction:** GTA 5 — strong lock-on heritage and large carried arsenal. GTA 6 — more grounded aiming, heavier presentation and contextual weapon handling shown/reported in previews.
- **US Standard price:** GTA 5 — $59.99 at original 2013 launch. GTA 6 — $79.99 digital Standard Edition.
- **PC status:** GTA 5 — available on PC. GTA 6 — no PC release date announced as of Oct. 22, 2026.

Important: Rockstar has not published an official square-mile measurement for GTA 6's map, so claims that Leonida is "2x" or "3x" the size of GTA 5 should not be presented as established fact unless tied to a clearly identified estimate or preview source.

## The Biggest Difference Is Not Map Size. It Is Scope.

GTA 5 was enormous for 2013, but its world was still built around one major city, the countryside of Blaine County and a design target that included PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 hardware. GTA 6 starts from a different baseline. Rockstar describes Leonida as a state-sized setting built around Vice City and several distinct regions rather than one city surrounded by rural space.

Rockstar has officially named the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park alongside Vice City. That matters more than an unofficial map-size percentage. The visible goal is variety: dense urban streets, islands and marinas, wetlands, industrial towns, coastline and wilderness all belong to the same open world.

The safest comparison is therefore not "GTA 6 is exactly twice as big." It is that GTA 6 appears broader in geographic identity and denser in activity. The August 2026 Extended Look, captured from the PS5 version, also showed crowded interiors, contextual interactions and a larger range of everyday activities than GTA 5 demonstrated at launch.

## GTA 6 Drops GTA 5's Three-Character Experiment for Jason and Lucia

GTA 5 built its campaign around Michael, Franklin and Trevor. The constant switching let Rockstar tell three overlapping stories: a retired criminal dragged back in, an ambitious younger hustler and an unpredictable career criminal.

GTA 6 narrows that structure to Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Rockstar's official story description says the pair are forced to rely on each other after an easy score goes wrong and pulls them into a criminal conspiracy across Leonida. That makes the relationship itself part of the game's central tension rather than simply another route into missions.

The Extended Look shows that players can still experience both protagonists in action, but the narrative framing is more intimate than GTA 5's three-way structure. GTA 5 asked how three very different criminals collide. GTA 6 is asking what happens when two people build a life and a criminal partnership at the same time.

## The World Looks More Interactive, Not Just More Detailed

The visual jump from GTA 5 is obvious, but higher resolution is the least interesting part. The more meaningful upgrade is how often the world appears to react to the player. Rockstar's 2026 footage showed contextual interactions with people and objects, busy indoor spaces, optional activities and small actions that make downtime feel playable rather than decorative.

That is closer to the interaction philosophy Rockstar developed in Red Dead Redemption 2 than to GTA 5's more arcade-focused world. It does not mean every NPC has a full simulation, and Rockstar has not claimed that. It means the official footage puts more emphasis on social density and situational interaction than GTA 5 did in its original 2013 campaign.

For players, that could be the biggest day-to-day change. A larger map only matters if there is more to notice and do inside it.

## Combat Appears More Grounded Than GTA 5, but Some Details Are Still Preview-Based

GTA 5's shooting was designed around fast third-person action, generous lock-on options and immediate access to a large weapon inventory. GTA 6's 2026 footage presents combat with more physical weight. Characters aim and move more deliberately, recoil is visually stronger, and some combat scenes force Jason or Lucia to handle weapons around what they are carrying or doing in the environment.

Preview coverage also reports a greater emphasis on free aiming and configurable assistance rather than the aggressive lock-on feel many players associate with GTA 5. Because those details come from an unreleased build and press demonstrations, they should be treated as pre-launch information rather than permanent settings.

The important confirmed takeaway is the direction: GTA 6 is presenting gunfights as more contextual and less detached from the rest of the world. Rockstar is not simply adding new weapons; it is changing how combat sits inside movement, interaction and mission flow. See the [weapons database](/weapons) for what has been shown so far.

## The Wanted System Is Becoming More About Identification

GTA 5's wanted system is easy to read. Commit a crime, gain stars, break line of sight and stay outside the police search area long enough to lose the heat. It works, but it often feels like a chase against icons on a minimap.

GTA 6's Extended Look and 2026 preview reporting point to a more information-driven system. The footage shows a six-position wanted display, and preview coverage describes police working with details about suspects and vehicles rather than instantly knowing the player's exact location. Rockstar has not published a full technical breakdown, so the exact rules should remain qualified until launch.

What is clear is that GTA 6 is trying to make escape feel less binary. Changing vehicles, breaking visual contact and managing what police know about the suspects appear to matter more than simply driving outside a search cone. That is a meaningful systemic change from GTA 5 even before we know every rule. Track it in the [wanted-level guide](/tools/wanted-level-guide).

## Driving and Vehicles Have to Serve a More Varied Leonida

GTA 5 is still one of the easiest open-world games to pick up and drive because its cars are responsive and forgiving. GTA 6 footage suggests Rockstar is adding more visible suspension movement, collision detail and vehicle weight without abandoning the fast pace expected from the series.

Leonida also expands the role of non-car travel. The official material repeatedly shows boats, airboats, watercraft, aircraft and long coastal routes. That makes sense in a world built around the Keys, wetlands and shoreline. The difference is not simply a bigger garage; the geography gives more vehicle types a reason to exist. Browse the [vehicle database](/vehicles) to see what has been confirmed.

Until reviewers can test the final build, claims about exact handling physics should remain descriptive rather than absolute. The footage supports "more physical-looking," not a promise that GTA 6 is becoming a driving simulator.

## GTA 6 Costs More at Launch

In the United States, the digital Standard Edition of GTA 6 is listed at $79.99 on PlayStation and Xbox, while the Ultimate Edition is $99.99. Digital pre-orders include a seven-day preload window, with Rockstar confirming preloading from November 12 ahead of the November 19 release.

That price is higher than the $59.99 console price GTA 5 launched with in 2013. It also puts GTA 6 above the $69.99 standard price that became common for many current-generation blockbuster games. Whether the extra cost feels justified will depend on the final game, not the size of the marketing campaign.

Demand is already unusually high, but the numbers need careful wording. Sensor Tower estimated 6.45 million digital pre-orders and about $630 million in consumer spending around October 20, 2026. Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed that unit count, so it should be described as a third-party estimate, not official sales data.

## What About GTA 6 on PC?

As of October 22, 2026, Rockstar officially lists GTA 6 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC release date has been announced.

A PC version is widely expected because GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 both reached PC after their console launches, but precedent is not confirmation. For an evergreen comparison page, the accurate wording is simple: GTA 6 launches on current-generation PlayStation and Xbox consoles on November 19, 2026, and Rockstar has not announced PC timing.

## So, Is GTA 6 a Bigger Upgrade Than GTA 5 Was?

In raw technology, yes: thirteen years of hardware, engine and design progress separate the games. But the more useful answer is that GTA 6 appears to change the texture of play as much as the presentation. Two protagonists replace three, Leonida expands the geographic range, interactions are denser, police encounters use more information, and combat is framed with more physical context.

GTA 5 was built to make chaos fast and accessible. GTA 6 looks designed to make that chaos leave more traces. The final judgment still has to wait for the retail version, but the official material already shows a sequel trying to evolve systems rather than simply rebuild Los Santos with better graphics.

## GTA 6 vs GTA 5 FAQs

### Is GTA 6 bigger than GTA 5?

Rockstar has shown a broader state of Leonida with multiple named regions, but it has not published an official square-mile map size. Treat exact "2x bigger" or "3x bigger" claims as estimates unless Rockstar later confirms them.

### How many playable characters are in GTA 6?

Rockstar's story centers on two playable protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. GTA 5 centered on three: Michael, Franklin and Trevor.

### Does GTA 6 have six wanted stars?

The 2026 Extended Look shows a six-position wanted display, and preview coverage reports the return of a six-star maximum. Rockstar has not yet published a complete official guide to what each level does.

### How much is GTA 6?

The US digital Standard Edition is listed at $79.99, while the Ultimate Edition is $99.99 on PlayStation and Xbox storefronts.

### When does GTA 6 release?

Grand Theft Auto VI releases November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar says digital preloading begins November 12.

### Is GTA 6 coming to PC?

No PC release date has been announced as of October 22, 2026. Rockstar currently lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S for launch.

title: From Airboats to Executive Jets: Every GTA 6 Boat, Plane & Helicopter Spotted So Far
subtitle: Airboats, executive jets, and the Sea Sparrow on the cover
excerpt: Leonida is ocean, swamp, and open sky — so boats and aircraft matter as much as supercars in GTA 6. Here's the full watercraft and aircraft rundown from both trailers and the Extended Look, from the Airgator to the Mammoth Dodo.
content:
Everyone's busy arguing about which supercar tops the speed charts in GTA 6. Meanwhile, Rockstar quietly made Leonida a state where you spend as much time on the water and in the air as on the road. Vice City is surrounded by ocean. Meanwhile, the Grassrivers wetlands cover the whole northwest. Down south, the Leonida Keys dangle off the southern tip like bait. If you can't fly or sail in this game, you're missing half the map.

Here's everything spotted across [both trailers](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKUW7_I4QwA, the August 2026 Extended Look, and the key art — organized by where you'll actually use them.


| Type | Examples | Best For |
|------|----------|----------|
| Airboats | Swamp boats | Everglades, shallow water |
| Speedboats | Various | Coastal travel, escapes |
| Yachts | Luxury vessels | Open water |
| Planes | Small aircraft | Long-distance travel |
| Helicopters | Various | Quick transport, missions |

## Boats and watercraft: the real Leonida meta

![Boat in GTA 6 waters](/img/boat.jpg)

The humble airboat might be the most important vehicle in GTA 6. Trailer footage shows Airgator fan boats carving through the Grassrivers marshes — flat-bottomed, deafening, and the only sane way to cross swamp that chews up trucks. Gator hunting is confirmed as an activity, so expect airboats to be your work vehicle out in the wetlands.

Then there's Jason's own boat. You'll spot the Lurepredator L35P fishing boat in the Extended Look, and community spotters have tied it to Jason's daily life — it fits the guy who lives at a boatyard and does fishing trips with his friend Cal Hampton. If the Lurepredator is buyable, that's your early-game workhorse: fishing income on one side, smuggling cover on the other. (Speculation: we don't know which boats are purchasable yet, but Jason's tied to this one for a reason.)

Rockstar has actually named very few vehicles — only seven so far, per frame-by-frame community breakdowns — and two of them are boats. For coastal missions, the Shitzu Squalo speedboat ships with the Ultimate Edition ($99.99 tier) for coastal missions, and the Crest Kayak is confirmed by name too. Kayaks. In Grand Theft Auto. Someone at Rockstar North wants you to paddle.

At the deep end of the marina, you'll find serious money: an Azimut Atlantis 45 yacht-style cruiser, Riva 86 Domino and Rivamare models, Sunseeker 80, and even a cruise ship spotted in trailer backgrounds. Jet skis (Speedophile Seashark) and a Sea-Doo RXT-X 300 cover the personal watercraft crowd. Rockstar also teased port heists with the BTN Delmar cargo ship.

## Aircraft: planes and helicopters

![Helicopter in GTA 6](/img/heli.jpg)

The skies over Leonida are busy. Trailer spotters confirmed the Buckingham Shamal executive jet, the Buckingham Luxor, and the JoBuilt Mammatus — a light prop plane that looks perfect for regional airport runs. Unlike regular planes, the Mammoth Dodo seaplane can land on coastal water, which, in a state shaped like Florida, is basically a cheat code. And the Western Company Duster crop duster is the wild card: a vintage biplane that screams "Brian Heder's old smuggling days." Remember that quote: "I hauled so much grass in that plane, I could make the state of Leonida levitate."

Helicopters? Look closely at the official cover art and you'll find the Sea Sparrow — amphibious, with water landing pontoons, ideal for the Keys. The Nagasaki Buzzard attack chopper returns with its twin miniguns for anyone with bad intentions and a five-star problem. The Buckingham Swift covers luxury travel, the Buckingham Maverick and Police Maverick handle civilian and law-enforcement duty, and the Buckingham SuperVolito Carbon shows up in trailer flyovers.

One honest warning: speedrunner compilations from the Extended Look clocked the Pegassi Tempesta topping 198 mph on an airport runway. That was a supercar on tarmac. How aircraft handling feels — especially the Duster's low-and-slow crop runs — is pure speculation until November 19.

## The ground game still matters

For completeness: Jason's daily driver is the Vapid Ganado, a two-door coupe-ute styled like a classic Ford Ranchero — very "Keys local." His bike is the new Principe Alvino V1 superbike, seen doing wheelies in the Extended Look. Brian Heder rolls in a Vapid Caracara 4x4 (Ford Raptor energy, whip antenna and all). Community analysts have confirmed names for 142 vehicles previously known only by silhouette, with the Bravado Banshee, Pegassi Zorrusso, Furia, and Tempesta among returning exotics.


See all land vehicles in our [Confirmed Vehicle List](/news/confirmed-vehicle-list-leonida). Explore the waterways in our [GTA 6 Map Guide](/news/gta-6-map-guide-leonida-regions-size).

## The takeaway

GTA 6's vehicle list is a geography lesson. Airboats for the swamp. Seaplanes for the Keys. Executive jets for the Vice City skyline. Rockstar built a state with ocean, marsh, and open sky, then gave you a vehicle for every square mile of it. When preload opens November 12, the first thing I'm doing isn't stealing a supercar. It's finding a boat.

title: GTA 6 Weapons: Every Confirmed Gun, Melee Weapon & Gunplay Change
subtitle: Rockstar has shown pistols, revolvers, rifles, SMGs, shotguns, explosives and melee weapons — but which names are officially confirmed and which are just fan guesses? Here's the full breakdown.
excerpt: Rockstar has shown pistols, revolvers, rifles, SMGs, shotguns, explosives and melee weapons — but which names are officially confirmed and which are just fan guesses? Here's the full breakdown.
content:
GTA 6 is shaping up to have a much more physical and deliberate combat system than GTA 5. Rockstar has already shown pistols, revolvers, assault rifles, SMGs, shotguns, sniper-style rifles, explosives and several objects that could function as melee weapons.

The important part is separating what Rockstar has actually confirmed from what players have identified by appearance.

Rockstar has explicitly named the **Girardi ES9**, **Klose K17** and **Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers** in official edition material. Other names, including the **Duke 556**, **Moreland 850**, **Mustang .357** and **Nipper .38**, can be read or have been identified from official gameplay, artwork and screenshots. Beyond those, several weapons clearly resemble real-world MP5, AK, AR, M249 and tactical shotgun designs, but Rockstar has not officially given all of them those names.

With GTA 6 scheduled for **November 19, 2026**, we now have enough official footage to build a fairly detailed picture of its arsenal and, more importantly, how Rockstar is changing the way guns actually work.


| Category | Examples | Availability |
|----------|----------|--------------|
| Handguns | Pistols, revolvers | Common |
| Rifles | Assault rifles | Ammu-Nation |
| SMGs | Submachine guns | Ammu-Nation |
| Shotguns | Pump, auto | Ammu-Nation |
| Heavy | RPG, minigun | Rare, late-game |
| Melee | Knife, bat | Various |
| Throwables | Grenades, molotovs | Ammu-Nation |

## GTA 6 Weapons List: What Is Actually Confirmed?

There is no official complete GTA 6 weapons list yet. Rockstar has instead revealed the arsenal gradually through Trailer 1, [Trailer 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKUW7_I4QwA, promotional screenshots, Ultimate Edition material and the August 2026 Extended Look.

That creates three different levels of certainty.

| Weapon | Type | Current status |
|---|---|---|
| Girardi ES9 | Pistol | Officially named by Rockstar |
| Klose K17 | Pistol | Officially named by Rockstar |
| Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers | Revolver | Officially named by Rockstar |
| Duke 556 | Assault rifle | Name shown in official gameplay |
| Moreland 850 | Shotgun | Name shown/reported from official gameplay |
| Mustang .357 | Revolver | Name visible in official imagery |
| Nipper .38 | Compact handgun | Name identified from official artwork |
| Capo-branded pistol | Handgun | Weapon shown, full model name unclear |
| MP5-style SMG | Submachine gun | Shown, community/press identification |
| AK-style rifle | Assault rifle | Shown, exact name unconfirmed |
| AR-pattern carbines | Rifle/carbine | Shown, exact models unconfirmed |
| Double-barrel shotgun | Shotgun | Shown |
| Tactical semi-auto shotgun | Shotgun | Shown, model name unconfirmed |
| Bolt-action rifle | Rifle | Shown, exact model unconfirmed |
| Grenade launcher | Heavy weapon | Clearly shown |
| Light machine gun | Machine gun | Shown, exact name unconfirmed |
| Molotov cocktail | Throwable | Shown in gameplay |

The distinction matters. A firearm appearing in Rockstar footage confirms that some version of it exists in GTA 6. It does not automatically confirm the real-world firearm name that players think inspired it.

## GTA 6 Handguns and Revolvers

Handguns are currently the best-documented part of the GTA 6 arsenal.

### Girardi ES9

The **Girardi ES9** is associated with Jason Duval and is one of the few weapons Rockstar has named directly. Its design is widely compared with the Beretta 92 family, although that real-world comparison comes from visual analysis rather than an official Rockstar description.

Rockstar's Ultimate Edition material includes a personalized version of Jason's Girardi ES9, which suggests weapon finishes and character-specific variants will play some role in customization.

### Klose K17

Lucia Caminos is associated with the **Klose K17**, another handgun officially named by Rockstar.

Earlier fan descriptions have compared it with several compact and polymer-framed pistols, but Rockstar has not identified a real-world equivalent. Calling it a specific Bersa, Glock or SIG model as fact would therefore go beyond what has actually been confirmed.

Like Jason's ES9, Lucia's K17 receives a personalized variant with the Ultimate Edition.

### Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers

The **Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers** are among the clearest officially named GTA 6 weapons. They are included with the Ultimate Edition and shown with distinctive personalized finishes.

The design resembles a large-frame double-action revolver, but Rockstar has not attached a real-world manufacturer or model to it.

### Mustang .357

The **Mustang .357** appears in official imagery involving Leonida bikers and carries Duke Arms branding.

Its heavy revolver shape has drawn comparisons with the Colt Python. That also gives it an obvious visual connection to the powerful revolvers associated with 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, although it is better described as a spiritual callback than a confirmed returning weapon.

### Nipper .38

The compact **Nipper .38** has also been identified from official GTA 6 artwork. Lucia is shown carrying the small sidearm, giving GTA 6 another handgun option distinct from her K17.

Rockstar has not published damage, magazine capacity, price or other statistics for it.

### Capo Pistol

A handgun carrying **Capo** branding appears with Raul Bautista and has also been associated with Jason's liquor-store robbery footage.

The important distinction is that Capo appears to be an in-universe manufacturer or brand. The exact model name of the pistol has not been officially established. Its overall design resembles a modernized 1911-style handgun, but that remains a visual comparison.

## GTA 6 Rifles, SMGs and Shotguns

![SMG weapon in GTA 6](/img/smg-gun.jpg)

Rockstar has shown considerably more long guns than it has officially named.

The **Duke 556** is one of the strongest examples. Its name appears during the Extended Look when a rifle can be picked up during combat. Other Duke-branded carbines appear throughout Rockstar's promotional material, suggesting Duke Arms will be one of Leonida's major fictional firearms manufacturers.

Several SMGs have also appeared. One strongly resembles an **MP5-pattern submachine gun**, while other compact firearms have been compared with MAC and Uzi-style designs. Both Jason and Lucia have been shown using automatic weapons during criminal jobs, but most of these guns still lack confirmed in-game names.

Shotguns appear to have a larger role than they did in many GTA 5 encounters.

The **Moreland 850** appears during the Extended Look and has been identified as a pump-action shotgun. Rockstar also shows another pump shotgun being handled one-handed by Lucia while she carries loot with her other arm. Double-barrel and tactical semi-automatic shotgun designs have appeared elsewhere in official footage and screenshots.

Long-range firearms include bolt-action and scoped rifles seen in Leonida's rural environments. Some have been compared with Remington 700 and M1A-style designs, but those comparisons should not be mistaken for official GTA 6 weapon names.

## Heavy Weapons, Explosives and Throwables

GTA 6 is not abandoning the series' heavier firepower.

Trailer 2 shows **Lucia firing a grenade launcher at pursuing police vehicles**, making the launcher one of the easiest heavy weapons to verify from official footage. A large light machine gun also appears during the Phil's Ammu-Nation commercial, although its exact in-game model has not been confirmed.

The Extended Look also shows Molotov cocktails and explosive combat scenarios. Grenades and other throwable equipment have appeared or been reported around the gameplay showcase, but Rockstar has not yet published a final throwable inventory.

Expect the complete explosives category to become clearer once the game launches and Ammu-Nation's stock can be inspected directly.

## What Melee Weapons Are in GTA 6?

This is one area where many existing GTA 6 weapon lists overstate what has been confirmed.

Official Rockstar material has shown objects including a **baseball bat, hammer, pool cue, minigolf club and switchblade**. Lucia is also shown using close-range contextual combat during the Extended Look, including an environmental interaction involving a stiletto heel.

However, seeing a pool cue or golf club in a screenshot does not prove that it will appear as a permanent weapon-wheel item.

For now, the safest conclusion is that GTA 6 clearly expands close-quarters and environmental combat, while the final list of equipable melee weapons remains unknown.

## Jason and Lucia Have Different Signature Weapons

Rockstar is giving Jason and Lucia noticeably different combat identities.

Jason's personalized sidearm is the **Girardi ES9**, while Lucia's is the **Klose K17**. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition content reinforces that distinction by providing individualized weapon variants for both protagonists.

The gameplay presentation also shows differences in how characters handle weapons depending on the situation.

Lucia can fire a shotgun one-handed while carrying stolen goods in her other hand. Jason and Lucia can pick weapons up during combat, switch between firearms and interact with equipment without the older GTA feeling of carrying an invisible armory at all times.

That is a meaningful shift. Weapons are becoming physical objects connected to what the character is carrying and doing rather than simply icons stored inside a menu.

## How GTA 6 Gunplay Is Different From GTA 5

The weapon list is only half the story. GTA 6's combat appears to have been redesigned around slower, more deliberate shooting.

Preview coverage reports that GTA 6 moves away from GTA 5's strong default lock-on behavior. Free aiming plays a larger role, while adjustable aim assistance or aim "stickiness" still helps controller users. Rockstar has not published the complete aiming settings, so the exact launch options remain subject to change.

Recoil also appears more important. Preview reports describe automatic rifles as harder to control during sustained fire, making short bursts and measured shots more useful than simply holding the trigger.

The Extended Look also reveals several broader combat changes.

Dropped weapons remain available to grab during fights. Weapon handling changes according to what a character is carrying. The HUD includes separate **Health, Stamina and Focus** systems, while Focus can slow combat and help identify vulnerable areas on targets and vehicles.

Vehicle damage looks more granular as well. Tires, body panels and other components react visibly to gunfire, making shooting during chases more tactical than simply emptying magazines into a health bar.

## GTA 6 Has a New Weapon and Inventory System

GTA 5 essentially allowed Michael, Franklin and Trevor to carry an entire gun shop.

GTA 6 is moving toward a more restricted loadout.

The Extended Look shows a redesigned weapon interface with separate **Weapons** and **Items** sections. Firearms, equipment and consumables occupy defined slots rather than being buried inside GTA 5's enormous circular arsenal.

Preview reporting also points to limits on the number of long guns Jason and Lucia can carry at once. That would force players to think about a loadout before a major robbery instead of bringing every rifle, shotgun and launcher they own.

This could become one of the biggest differences between GTA 5 and GTA 6. Your choice of pistol, long gun and equipment may actually matter before a mission begins.

### Focus Could Change How GTA 6 Shootouts Work

GTA 6's new **Focus** system deserves particular attention.

The Extended Look shows a dedicated Focus meter alongside health and stamina. During combat, the ability slows the action and highlights vulnerable areas, creating obvious similarities with Red Dead Redemption's Dead Eye system and Michael's slow-motion shooting ability in GTA 5.

The key difference is how it fits the rest of GTA 6's combat design.

If standard aiming is less dependent on hard lock-on, Focus becomes a tactical resource rather than simply a cinematic power. Players may save it for drivers, tires, exposed enemies or other high-value targets during difficult encounters.

### Civilians and Police React Differently to Weapons

Walking through Vice City with a gun in your hand may have consequences even before you pull the trigger.

Preview coverage describes civilians reacting to visible firearms, while GTA 6's broader crime system places more emphasis on witnesses and what police actually know about the suspect.

The Extended Look also confirms the return of a **six-star wanted level**, replacing GTA 5's five-star maximum. Police can build information around the people, clothing and vehicles involved in crimes rather than behaving as if every officer instantly knows exactly who committed an offence.

That makes holstering a weapon, changing appearance and avoiding witnesses potentially as important as winning the gunfight itself.

### Where Can You Buy Guns in GTA 6?

![Ammu-Nation gun store](/img/ammu-nation.jpg)

**Ammu-Nation is officially returning.**

Trailer 2 includes an in-universe television commercial for **Phil's Ammu-Nation** at roughly the 2:09 mark. Phil stands in front of racks packed with rifles, shotguns and other firearms while enthusiastically advertising the store.

Rockstar has not yet confirmed GTA 6 weapon prices, progression requirements or the exact inventory sold at each branch.

Trailer 1 also shows the **Port Gellhorn Pawn & Gun**, which suggests Leonida may offer alternatives to the traditional Ammu-Nation chain.

That could fit GTA 6's broader economy well. Players may end up buying standard firearms from Ammu-Nation while finding different weapons, stolen goods or cheaper equipment through pawn shops and less formal dealers.

Our [GTA 6 money guide](/news/gta-6-money-guide-robberies-fences-economy) covers the robbery and fencing systems that should help fund those purchases.

### Which GTA 6 Weapons Should You Get First?

No reliable weapon tier list exists yet because nobody has final damage, accuracy, recoil, price or unlock data.

Still, the weapon classes Rockstar has shown already point toward a practical early-game setup.

A dependable pistol such as Jason's Girardi ES9 or Lucia's Klose K17 should cover routine encounters without taking up a long-gun slot. A pump-action shotgun looks ideal for stores, interiors and close-range robberies, while a Duke 556-style rifle should make more sense once larger shootouts and police encounters become common.

Long-range rifles could become particularly useful outside Vice City, especially around the rural, hunting and swamp regions visible across the [Leonida map](/map).

That is strategy based on the systems Rockstar has shown, not a confirmed best-weapons ranking.

### Will GTA 6 Have Weapon Customization?

Some level of weapon personalization is already confirmed.

The Ultimate Edition includes personalized versions of Jason's Girardi ES9 and Lucia's Klose K17, plus the Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers. Rockstar artwork also shows different finishes, optics and weapon configurations.

What Rockstar has not revealed is the complete customization system.

We still do not know whether GTA 6 will use GTA 5-style Ammu-Nation upgrades, GTA Online-style Mk II systems, a dedicated gunsmith interface or something closer to Red Dead Redemption 2.

### How Many Weapons Are in GTA 6?

Rockstar has not announced a final number.

Roughly 20 distinct firearms can currently be separated across official trailers, screenshots and gameplay depending on how similar variants are counted. That number grows when throwables and possible melee weapons are included. PC Gamer's pre-release analysis, for example, identified 19 distinct firearms from official material.

Claims that GTA 6 has exactly 30, 40 or any other fixed number of weapons should therefore be treated cautiously until Rockstar publishes the complete arsenal or the game launches.


## Sources

- [Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI)
- [GTA 6 Trailer 2 (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FKUW7_I4QwA)
- [GTA 6 Launch Trailer (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rz1B4B2yBZY)

## GTA 6 Weapons FAQ

### What guns are confirmed in GTA 6?

Rockstar has directly named weapons including the Girardi ES9, Klose K17 and Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers. Official footage and imagery also reveal the Duke 556, Moreland 850, Mustang .357, Nipper .38 and several currently unnamed rifles, SMGs, shotguns and heavy weapons.

### Does GTA 6 have an AK-47?

An AK-pattern rifle appears in official GTA 6 material, but Rockstar has not confirmed that its in-game name is "AK-47."

### Does GTA 6 have an MP5?

An SMG resembling the MP5 family has appeared in official footage. MP5 is a real-world visual identification rather than a confirmed Rockstar weapon name.

### Is Ammu-Nation in GTA 6?

Yes. Trailer 2 includes an advertisement for Phil's Ammu-Nation, confirming the fictional gun-store chain returns in GTA 6.

### Does GTA 6 have melee weapons?

Official material shows baseball bats, hammers, pool cues, clubs and a switchblade, while the Extended Look demonstrates contextual close-range combat. Rockstar has not yet confirmed which of those objects can permanently be equipped.

### Does GTA 6 have a weapon wheel?

Yes. The Extended Look shows a redesigned inventory interface with Weapons and Items sections, suggesting a more restricted and equipment-focused loadout than GTA 5.

### Will GTA 6 have auto-aim?

Preview reporting says strong GTA-style auto-lock is no longer the default behavior, with freer aiming and adjustable aim assistance taking its place. Rockstar has not yet published the final aiming-settings menu.

### Final Word

GTA 6 is not simply adding more guns to GTA 5's formula.

Everything Rockstar has shown points toward weapons having more physical weight in the game. Jason and Lucia have identifiable sidearms, long guns occupy meaningful loadout space, dropped weapons can become part of a fight, characters handle firearms differently when carrying loot, recoil matters more and the new Focus system adds another layer to precision shooting.

The final weapon count is still unknown, and many familiar names circulating online are real-world comparisons rather than official GTA 6 labels.

What is already clear is that gunfights in Leonida are being built around **weapon choice, positioning, recoil, inventory limits and consequences**, rather than simply opening a giant weapon wheel and selecting whatever has the highest damage stat.

With GTA 6 launching on **November 19, 2026**, the full arsenal is almost here.

title: How GTA 6 Was Really Made: 4,711 People, a Scrapped Continent, and a Two-Hour Detour
subtitle: Rockstar finally opened up about building GTA 6: 4,711 staff, a scrapped two-continent map, and the two-hour detour that convinced the team they'd made something special.
excerpt: Rockstar finally opened up about building GTA 6: 4,711 staff, a scrapped two-continent map, and the two-hour detour that convinced the team they'd made something special.
content:
For over a decade, Rockstar said almost nothing about how GTA 6 was actually being built. Then, five weeks before launch, publishing head Jennifer Kolbe and the game's three development leads sat down with Bloomberg's Jason Schreier in Edinburgh — and the dam finally broke.

The feature, published October 14 in [Bloomberg Businessweek](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2026-10-14/grand-theft-auto-vi-inside-rockstar-s-race-to-finish-the-most-anticipated-game-ever), is the first time Rockstar has openly discussed the struggle behind GTA 6. The original plan was far wilder than what we're getting, and one accidental two-hour detour convinced the team they'd made something special.

![GTA 6 Leonida sunset over Vice City skyline](/img/vice-sunset.svg)

## Why Did Rockstar Nearly Double Its Staff to Build GTA 6?

Rockstar employed 2,441 people when Red Dead Redemption 2 shipped in 2018. By August 2026, Bloomberg reports that had nearly doubled to 4,711 across 12 offices — bigger than any direct competitor. Head of development Rob Nelson said the team projected how many NPCs Leonida would need, looked at its capacity, and found the gap "horrifying." The answer: a whole new Los Angeles studio of writers, producers, and directors whose only job is NPCs.

| GTA 6 Development | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rockstar staff (2018, RDR2 launch) | 2,441 |
| Rockstar staff (Aug 2026) | 4,711 |
| Growth | +93% (nearly doubled) |
| Studios worldwide | 12 |
| New LA studio focus | NPCs only |

## What Was Project Americas — and Why Did Rockstar Shrink It?

Here's the one that rewrites GTA history: GTA 6 started life as Project Americas, aiming to feature big swaths of land across both North and South America. Not a bigger Vice City — a two-continent crime epic.

That scope later narrowed to Leonida and its Miami-inspired hub. The game still slipped twice, from May to November 2026, and Phil Hooker admitted an earlier release was possible — it just wouldn't have matched the team's vision. "Even within the last few months, we've changed things," he said.

Part of the delay came from Red Dead Redemption 2: its scope pulled senior staff away for years, and veterans including co-founder Dan Houser left after it shipped.

## How Does the World Keep Interrupting You in GTA 6?

The best story in the interview isn't a number — it's a detour. Late in development, Hooker set off for a story mission in a test build and never arrived. A fender bender became a roadside argument. A pedestrian's insult became a fight. An unattended till became a robbery. A police chase, a stolen car, and a raid on a compound later, a fence handed him a new lead. Two hours had passed.

He says everyone left that review convinced that if they held their nerve, they had something special. That anecdote explains the NPC studio, the headcount, and the delays: Leonida is built to interrupt you.

It also shows where GTA 6 sits between its predecessors: Red Dead Redemption 2 told a more nuanced story than GTA 5, and GTA 6 leans toward Red Dead while balancing the two. You can still throw $20 bills at strippers, but the game also wants you to empathize with its Bonnie-and-Clyde-inspired leads. Building a game around two people whose bond ebbs and flows with player choices took years of work on traditional AI — "the traditional kind, not ChatGPT," as Schreier put it. More in our [characters guide](/characters).

## What Did Rockstar Say About Crunch, Leaks, and the Union Fight?

On crunch, Kolbe was blunt: "We're not going to finish this game by crunching." She cited more staff, revised planning, and extra pay or time off for extra hours — while admitting experiences may differ. Schreier reports largely positive staff views, but in a studio of 4,711 people, "largely positive" and "experiences may differ" can both be true.

Security is the sorer subject. After the 2022 leaks, Rockstar required five days a week in the office from 2024 and blocked tool access from home. Then the August 2026 "CyberLeek" leak happened anyway, raising doubts about whether the policy works.

Then there's the 2025 firing of 34 employees, most part of a group trying to unionize. Rockstar says they shared confidential information; the group disputes that, and the tribunal case was expected to resolve at the end of October. Kolbe called the talks positive: "If they want a union, they will have a union."

## So What Does All of This Mean for November 19?

First, the money question Rockstar won't answer. Kolbe shot down the rumor that GTA 6 cost more than $1.5 billion — the price of Dubai's Burj Khalifa — but Schreier writes it is almost certainly the most expensive game ever made, possibly more than double the roughly $500 million other publishers stay under.

Whatever the figure, you'll pay the same at the till:

| Edition | Price | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | $79.99 | Physical + Digital |
| Ultimate | $99.99 | Digital only | Analysts forecast around 40 million copies and more than $3 billion in the first four months — an estimate, not a Rockstar promise. The same week, Rockstar dropped the [launch trailer](/news/gta-6-launch-trailer-breakdown) on October 15. Start planning your first drive with our [Leonida map guide](/map).

## What This Tells Us That Bloomberg Didn't Spell Out

Here's what the numbers actually mean: Rockstar spent 8 years and nearly doubled its workforce to build a game that started as a two-continent epic and ended as a single-state crime story. That's not scope creep — it's scope discipline. The Project Americas cut suggests Rockstar chose depth over breadth: a Leonida that interrupts you for two hours is worth more than two continents you rush through.

The 4,711 headcount also reframes the delay. This wasn't a game that slipped because it was in trouble. It slipped because Rockstar kept adding people to make the world denser, not to fix a broken game. The two-hour detour story proves it — Hooker wasn't testing a broken build, he was getting lost in a finished one.

title: GTA 6 Map Size: Evidence, Estimates and Comparison Limits
subtitle: Scale projections based on GPS telemetry leaks
excerpt: We have not verified an official area measurement or a traceable primary source for the map-size ratios previously published here. Here is how to assess GTA 6 map estimates.
content:
**Quick answer:** This article does not establish an official square-kilometer area for GTA VI or a verified multiplier against GTA V or Red Dead Redemption 2. The sources previously cited here did not provide a traceable basis for the ratios and quotations attributed to developers.

## What changed?

**Correction — October 27, 2026:** We withdrew unsupported developer attributions, numerical ratios, area estimates presented as established facts, and claims about fast travel and interior counts. Generic links to an outlet homepage or Rockstar's homepage do not substantiate a particular interview quotation. The earlier version is retained in our editorial remediation archive for accountability.

## What geography can readers check?

Rockstar's [Only in Leonida page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida) identifies Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. Those names establish destinations in the setting; they do not establish the area of a playable map.

Our [Leonida region guide](/news/gta-6-map-guide-leonida-regions-size) separates these destinations from questions about boundaries and travel systems.

## Why map-size estimates differ

A valid comparison needs the same measurement boundary in each game. A total including offshore water cannot be directly compared with a land-only area. Accessible interiors, underground spaces and a flat map footprint also describe different things.

A community reconstruction needs a stated scale, a reproducible method, dated source material and uncertainty. Matching a building to a real location may help an estimate, but does not prove the scale or arrangement of a fictional game world.

## What evidence would support a future comparison?

A developer quotation needs the exact interview, publication date and relevant passage or timestamp. A numerical measurement needs its units, boundary and method. A fan estimate needs attribution and must remain separate from an official measurement.

We will add a numerical comparison only after those details can be checked. Until then, this page provides no ranked area table and does not call a community projection a Rockstar-confirmed dimension.

## Explore the setting

See the [official GTA VI site](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI), our [region guide](/news/gta-6-map-guide-leonida-regions-size), and our [Port Gellhorn evidence guide](/news/gta-6-port-gellhorn-forgotten-coast-guide). The site's [fan map](/map) is an exploration aid, not an official map or surveying reference.
